Pourtime Support

For help with Pourtime, purchase restoration, your drink journal, or privacy questions, contact developer Zachary Wilson at clt@zackwilson.me.

Please include your app version, iOS version, and a description of the issue. You do not need to send your drink history or profile photo.

Restore Remove Ads

Open Profile → Settings → Restore Purchases while signed in to the Apple Account that made the purchase.

About your journal

Pourtime stores your drink records and optional profile on your device. Read the privacy policy.

Pourtime describes logged consumption; it does not estimate BAC, impairment, or when you will be sober.
